title: Low-stock view (threshold + nav count)
description: Low-stock view/filter for items at or below their per-item reorder threshold, with a nav count
spec:
1. Confirm items carry a per-item threshold (default 1) as defined by the item model.
2. Create an item with quantity at or below its threshold; confirm it is considered low-stock.
3. Open the low-stock view or filter chip; confirm only items with quantity <= threshold are listed.
4. Confirm an item with quantity above its threshold does not appear in the low-stock view.
5. Confirm the navigation surfaces a low-stock count that matches the number of low-stock items.
6. Adjust an item's quantity above its threshold; confirm it drops out of the low-stock view and the nav count decrements.
7. Confirm the view reuses the server-rendered list fragment and htmx idioms.
